questions.question: How many planets are there in our solar system?
questions.funFact: Pluto used to be counted as the ninth planet, but in 2006 scientists called it a 'dwarf planet' instead.

questions.question: Which is the largest planet in the solar system?
questions.funFact: Jupiter is so huge that more than 1,000 Earths could fit inside it.

questions.question: Which planet is closest to the Sun?
questions.funFact: Even though Mercury is nearest the Sun, Venus is the hottest planet because of its thick blanket of gas.

questions.question: The Sun is actually a star.
questions.funFact: The Sun looks bigger and brighter than other stars only because it is so much closer to us.

questions.question: The planet known as the 'Red Planet' is ___.
questions.funFact: Mars looks red because its soil is full of rusty iron, like reddish-brown dust.

questions.question: Which planet is famous for its beautiful rings?
questions.funFact: Saturn's rings are made of billions of pieces of ice and rock, some as small as dust and some as big as houses.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a planet?
questions.funFact: The Moon is not a planet; it is a satellite that goes around the Earth.

questions.question: Match each planet to its nickname.
questions.funFact: Earth is called the Blue Planet because so much of it is covered by blue oceans.

questions.question: Earth is the only planet known to have life on it.
questions.funFact: Earth has just the right air, water and warmth for plants, animals and people to live.

questions.question: The Moon is Earth's only natural ___.
questions.funFact: A satellite is an object that moves around a planet, and our Moon takes about a month to circle the Earth.

questions.question: Which is the smallest planet in our solar system?
questions.funFact: Mercury is the smallest of the eight planets, only a little bigger than our Moon.

questions.question: Arrange these planets in order, starting from the one closest to the Sun.
questions.funFact: A helpful way to remember the planet order is: 'My Very Easy Method Just Speeds Up Naming'.
